patch.sql:
select
    distinct l_orderkey || '-' || l_linenumber as order_line_id,
    l_orderkey as order_key,
    l_linenumber as line_number,
    l_partkey as part_key,
    l_suppkey as supplier_key,
    l_quantity as quantity,
    l_extendedprice as extended_price,
    l_discount as discount,
    l_tax as tax,
    l_returnflag as return_flag,
    l_shipdate as ship_date,
    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as net_revenue
from {{ source('raw', 'lineitem') }}
patch.explanation: The unique test on stg_lineitem.order_line_id failed with 5,639 duplicate rows. Raw lineitem contains exact duplicate rows (same orderkey and linenumber) as shown by grouping on l_orderkey, l_linenumber which returns counts >1. Since duplicates are identical across all columns, policy dictates deduplication in the staging model. Adding DISTINCT to the SELECT removes duplicate order_line_id rows, and try_patch confirms all tests now pass.
